paragraphs: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc (previously Caledonia Mining Corporation) was incorporated, effective February 5, 1992, by the amalgamation of three predecessor companies and was registered at the time under the Canada Business Corporations Act.

Following the creation of Caledonia its shares were listed on the TSX and quoted on the NASDAQ small caps market. On October 16, 1998, Caledonia announced that NASDAQ would no longer quote its securities for trading. Caledonia's stock commenced trading on the OTCQX in June 2005.

Effective April 1, 2006 the Company purchased 100% of the issued shares of the Zimbabwean company, CHZ, that held 100% of the shares of Blanket Mine. The purchase consideration was $1,000,000 and 20,000,000 shares of Caledonia. The Company acquired all the assets and assumed all the liabilities of CHZ.

The Company re-domiciled from Canada to Jersey using a legal process called "Continuance" on March 19, 2016. The Company operates under the Companies (Jersey) Law 1991, as amended, (the "Companies Law"). The Continuance had no effect on the Company's listing on the TSX or on the trading facilities on AIM in London or on the OTCQX in the United States of America.

On July 24, 2017, the Company announced that its shares would be listed on the NYSE American and trading began on July 27, 2017. The trading of the Company's shares on the OTCQX ceased upon the commencement of trading on the NYSE American.

Caledonia voluntary delisted its shares from the TSX on June 19, 2020. After the delisting, the Company remains a Canadian reporting issuer and has to comply with Canadian securities laws unless and until it can demonstrate that less than 2% of its beneficial shareholders are Canadian residents and who hold less than 2% of the Company's issued share capital. On December 2, 2021, Caledonia issued and listed 619,783 depositary receipts representing an equivalent number of shares on the VFEX raising gross proceeds of $7.8 million.

During the first two quarters of 2023 gross proceeds of $10.8 million were raised by issuing 781,749 depository interests which were subsequently listed on AIM and gross proceeds of $5.9 million were raised by issuing 425,765 depository receipts which were subsequently listed on the VFEX.
As at the date of this report Caledonia's securities trade on the NYSE American, AIM and VFEX under the ticker "CMCL".

paragraphs: An investment in our shares involves a high degree of risk and should be considered speculative. You should carefully consider the following risks set out below and other information before investing in our shares. If any event arising from these risks occurs, our business, prospects, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows could be adversely affected, the trading price of our shares could decline and all or part of any investment may be lost.

Our operations are highly speculative due to the high-risk nature of our business, which include the acquisition, financing, exploration, development of mineral infrastructure and operation of mines. The risks and uncertainties set out below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our operations. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, financial condition and operating results could be adversely affected. As a result, the trading price of our shares could decline and investors could lose part or all of their investment. Our business is subject to significant risks and past performance is no guarantee of future performance.

Failure to meet the applicable maintenance requirements of the NYSE American could result in our shares being delisted from the NYSE American. If we are delisted from the NYSE American, our shares may be eligible for trading on an over-the-counter market in the United States. In the event that we are not able to obtain a listing on another U.S. stock exchange or quotation service for our shares, it may be extremely difficult or impossible for shareholders to sell their shares in the United States. Moreover, if we are delisted from the NYSE American, but obtain a substitute listing for our shares in the United States, it may be on a market with less liquidity, and therefore potentially more price volatility, than the NYSE American. Shareholders may not be able to sell their shares on any such substitute U.S. market in the quantities, at the times, or at the prices that could potentially be available on a more liquid trading market. As a result of these factors, if our shares are delisted from the NYSE American, the price of our shares is likely to decline. In addition, a decline in the price of our shares will impair our ability to obtain financing in the future.

Following vesting of long-term incentive plan awards on April 1, 2026 and the subsequent issue of shares, we had 19,335,079 shares issued and outstanding. Awards under the incentive plan made to executives and certain other senior members of management on April 7, 2023, April 8, 2024, April 1, 2025 and April 1, 2026 consisting of a target of 80,773, 125,433, 110,830 and 132,360 Equity-settled Performance Units ("EPUs") respectively, are only to be settled in shares. 6,004 Equity Restricted Share Units ("ERSUs") were granted to a senior manager on April 1, 2025 with a balance of 4,125 as of April 2, 2026 after dividends were reinvested and following vesting of a third of his ERSUs on April 1, 2026. The EPUs and ERSUs that vest will be subject to a performance multiplier and a maximum amount of 150% of target EPUs could vest in all cases other than for EPUs granted to senior members of the project management team specifically responsible for delivery of the Bilboes Gold Project whose EPUs could vest in a maximum amount of 200% of target EPUs. Accordingly, providing for such a maximum amount, Caledonia could grant options on a further 1,345,171 shares as at the date of this Annual Report on the assumption that all other outstanding awards (other than the options mentioned above) are settled in cash at the request of the holders. As of April 2, 2026, our senior officers and directors beneficially owned or had an interest in, as a group, 2,922,715 shares (15.1% of our issued share capital). Sales of substantial amounts of our shares into the public market by our officers or directors or pursuant to the exercise of options, or even the perception by the market that such sales may occur, may lower the market price of our shares.

The economic viability of our revenues, operations and exploration and development projects is, and is expected to be, heavily dependent on the price of gold, which is particularly subject to fluctuation and has fluctuated significantly in recent years. The price of gold is affected by numerous factors beyond our control including, but not limited to: international economic and political conditions; expectations of inflation; international currency exchange rates; interest rates; global or regional consumption patterns; speculative activities; levels of supply and demand; increased production due to new mine developments and improved mining and production methods; availability and costs of metal substitutes; and inventory carrying costs. The effect of these factors on the price of gold, and therefore the economic viability of our operations, cannot be accurately predicted. As required by Zimbabwean legislation, Blanket Mine (1983) (Private) Limited ("Blanket"), the company which owns the Blanket mine ("Blanket Mine"), Caledonia Holdings Zimbabwe (Private) Limited ("CHZ"), as agent, and Bilboes Holdings (Private) Limited ("Bilboes Holdings") deliver their production to Fidelity Gold Refinery (Private) Limited ("Fidelity"), which refines the gold to a purity of 99.95%. 70% of the gold delivered to Fidelity is refined on a toll-treatment basis. For the 70% portion Caledonia retains ownership of the gold that is then exported by Caledonia to a refiner of its choice outside Zimbabwe which undertakes further processing and sells the resulting gold on the international market.

70% of the portion of toll refined metals produced by Blanket, less royalty and fees, is exported by Caledonia to Al Etihad Gold FZCO ("AEG", an accredited Dubai Good Delivery refinery) and Stonex Financial Limited (through accredited Good Delivery refineries in Dubai and South Africa), which make payment to Caledonia's bank account in Zimbabwe in USD.

paragraphs: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc (先前為 Caledonia Mining Corporation) 於 1992 年 2 月 5 日成立，由三個前身公司合併而成，當時在加拿大商事公司法下註冊。
Caledonia 成立後，其股票於 TSX 上市，並於 NASDAQ small caps 市場掛牌交易。1998 年 10 月 16 日，Caledonia 宣佈 NASDAQ 將不再於交易中掛牌其證券。Caledonia 的股票於 2005 年 6 月開始在 OTCQX 交易。
自 2006 年 4 月 1 日起，本公司購入 100% 百分比的已發行股份，屬於津巴布韋公司 CHZ，該公司持有 Blanket Mine 100% 百分比的股份。交易對價為 1,000,000 美元及 20,000,000 份本公司股份。本公司取得 CHZ 全部資產，並承擔其全部負債。
本公司於 2016 年 3 月 19 日透過名為 "Continuance" 的法律程序，從加拿大遷移至澤西。本公司根據 1991 年《澤西公司法》（經修訂）（"Companies Law"）運作。Continuance 不影響本公司在 TSX 的上市地位，也不影響在倫敦 AIM 的交易設施或在美國 OTCQX 的交易設施。
2017 年 7 月 24 日，本公司宣佈其股票將於 NYSE American 上市，並於 2017 年 7 月 27 日開始交易。本公司股票在 OTCQX 的交易於 NYSE American 開始交易時終止。

Caledonia 於 2020 年 6 月 19 日自願從 TSX 撤出上市。撤出後，本公司仍為加拿大報告發行者，除非能證明其受益股東中少於 2% 為加拿大居民且持有少於 2% 百分比的已發行股份，否則仍需遵守加拿大證券法規。2021 年 12 月 2 日，Caledonia 發行並於 VFEX 上市 619,783 份存託憑證，代表相同數量的股份，籌得 gross proceeds 為 7.8 百萬美元。
2023 年前兩個季度，透過發行 781,749 份存託權益，籌得 gross proceeds 為 10.8 百萬美元，並於 AIM 上市；透過發行 425,765 份存託憑證，籌得 gross proceeds 為 5.9 百萬美元，並於 VFEX 上市。
截至本報告日，Caledonia 的證券於 NYSE American、AIM 和 VFEX 以 "CMCL" 編碼交易。

paragraphs: 下列之「營運與財務評估及展望」部分旨在協助讀者瞭解影響本公司財務狀況及營運成果之因素，針對財務報表所涵蓋之歷史期間，以及管理階層對預期將對本公司未來財務狀況及營運成果產生重大影響之因素及趨勢之評估。本部分為財務報表之補充說明，應與本公司合併財務報表及其他財務資訊一併閱讀。本公司合併財務報表係依國際會計準則（IFRS）編製。本討論內容包含基於目前預期之展望性資訊，涉及風險與不確定性，例如本公司之計畫、目標與意圖。本公司實際結果可能與展望性陳述所顯示者有所差異。
影響本公司營運成果及主要業務之關鍵驅動因素為：
● 營業收入，其受以下因素影響：黃金價格，該價格以實際獲取之美元黃金價格計，會有所波動；以及
本公司之生產噸數及其中所含黃金含量，影響本公司在營運中所生產之黃金數量；
● 其他重大影響獲利之因素。營業收入
營業收入於2025會計年度增至267,663,000美元，較2024會計年度之183,018,000美元為高。所生產之黃金為77,896盎司（2024年：78,301盎司）。營業收入增加係因平均實際獲取之黃金價格提高至每盎司3,383美元（2024年：每盎司2,347美元），2025年銷售之盎司數較2024年為高（詳見下文），抵銷因實際品位及回收率較低所造成之影響。
平均實際獲取黃金價格每盎司為非IFRS衡量指標，管理階層認為此指標有助於利害關係人瞭解每盎司黃金之平均獲取價格。
本公司之收入主要來自Blanket Mine所生產之黃金銷售。因此，本公司之收入直接受實際獲取黃金價格之影響。所獲取之黃金價格可能波動甚大，且受本公司無法控制之因素影響。下表顯示2025及2024會計年度所獲取之平均實際黃金價格每盎司。

paragraphs: 投資本公司股份涉及高度風險，應視為投機性投資。您應仔細考慮下列風險及其他資訊，再決定是否投資本公司股份。若發生任何來自這些風險的事件，將可能對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況、營運結果或現金流產生不利影響，本公司股份的交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能損失全部或部分投資。
本公司業務具有高度投機性，原因在於本公司業務的高風險性質，包括礦業基礎設施的取得、融資、探勘、開發及礦場營運。下列所列風險與不確定性並非本公司唯一面臨的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉，或認為不重要，也可能影響本公司營運。若任何風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。因此，本公司股份的交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能損失全部或部分投資。

若未能符合紐約證券交易所美國證券板（NYSE American）的維持要求，本公司股份可能被從NYSE American除牌。若本公司股份被從NYSE American除牌，可能可在美國的場外市場進行交易。若本公司無法在其他美國股票交易所或 quotation service 上取得股份上市或掛牌，股東可能極其困難或無法在美國出售其股份。此外，若本公司被從NYSE American除牌，但能在美國取得替代上市場，可能是在流動性較低的市場，因此可能導致價格波動較大。股東可能無法在任何替代美國市場以任何數量、任何時間或任何價格出售其股份，與在較流動交易市場所能取得的價格相比。因此，若本公司股份被從NYSE American除牌，本公司股份的價格很可能下跌。此外，股份價格下跌將影響本公司未來取得融資的能力。

長期激勵計劃獎勵在2026年4月1日解禁後，隨後發行股份，本公司已發行及流通股份為19,335,079股。於2023年4月7日、2024年4月8日、2025年4月1日及2026年4月1日，授予執行長及其他高階管理人員的獎勵，分別為80,773、125,433、110,830及132,360股 Equity-settled Performance Units（"EPUs"），僅以股份結算。於2025年4月1日，授予一名高階經理人6,004 Equity Restricted Share Units（"ERSUs"），截至2026年4月2日，經股息再投資及解禁三分之一ERSUs後，餘額為4,125。解禁的EPUs及ERSUs將適用績效乘數，除專門負責Bilboes Gold Project交付的高階項目管理團隊成員所獲EPUs外，所有情況下EPUs最多可達目標EPUs的150%。因此，考慮到此最大數量，Caledonia可在本年度報告日，假設所有其他未結算獎勵（除上述選股外）以現金結算，可發行進一步1,345,171股選股。截至2026年4月2日，本公司高階主管及董事共同持有或有利益於本公司發行股份的15.1%（2,922,715股）。本公司高階主管或董事大量出售本公司股份至公開市場，或根據選股行權，甚至市場對此出售的觀感，可能降低本公司股份的市場價格。

本公司營收、營運及探勘與開發專案的經濟可行性，並預期將嚴重依賴黃金價格，而黃金價格特別容易波動，且近年來已大幅波動。黃金價格受許多超出本公司控制範疇的因素影響，包括但不限於：國際經濟與政治條件；通貨膨脹預期；國際貨幣匯率；利率；全球或區域消費模式；投機活動；供需水平；因新礦開發及採礦與生產技術改善而增加的生產；金屬替代品的可得性與成本；以及存貨持有成本。這些因素對黃金價格的影響，以及因此對本公司營運經濟可行性的影響，無法準確預測。根據津巴布韋法律，Blanket Mine (1983) (Private) Limited（"Blanket"），擁有Blanket礦（"Blanket Mine"）的公司，Caledonia Holdings Zimbabwe (Private) Limited（"CHZ"），作為代理人，以及Bilboes Holdings (Private) Limited（"Bilboes Holdings"），將其生產交付至Fidelity Gold Refinery (Private) Limited（"Fidelity"），Fidelity將黃金提煉至純度為99.95%。交付至Fidelity的70%黃金是以代工處理方式進行提煉。對於這70%部分，Caledonia保留黃金的所有權，然後由Caledonia出口至津巴布韋以外的選擇性煉金廠進行進一步處理並在國際市場出售。
70%的Blanket代工提煉金屬產出，扣除 royalty 及費用後，由Caledonia出口至Al Etihad Gold FZCO（"AEG"，認可的杜拜Good Delivery煉金廠）及Stonex Financial Limited（透過認可的杜拜及南非Good Delivery煉金廠），並以美元支付至Caledonia在津巴布韋的銀行帳戶。
